scope: HGTXR-SW second-goal submission target gap audit
direct_comparison_blocker: Current metric_track_center_px is documented as post-transform input-coordinate error, not confirmed sensor-pixel error; direct comparison with the 0.1812 px submission target is invalid until protocol and coordinate frame are matched.
required_alignment_checks: Verify coordinate frame and scale of metric_track_center_px against the paper's pixel error definition.
Verify EV-Eye split protocol and train/val/test sample counts against the paper's EX-Gaze-following split claim.
Verify whether current track-only event-count experiments cover the paper's hybrid scheduler mode, not only event-side tracking.
Verify whether P10/P5/P1 are computed on the same target points and coordinate frame as Table I in the submission draft.
Keep latency and hardware claims out of the software accuracy promotion path until a stronger full-width teacher exists.
experiment_implications: XR-64 remains the immediate P0 path because it is the only current leakage-safe mechanism for converting XR-63 oracle headroom into trainable supervision.
XR-65 temporal-lite residual is relevant only after XR-64 yields a non-collapsing checkpoint.
XR-66 confidence-gated local update is relevant only after no-train confidence/fallback diagnostics identify a usable subset.
XR-68 hardware/distillation compression is blocked until software accuracy improves with a stable full-width teacher.
